items.title_zh: 从“偷传代码”到开源整改，智谱风波折射AI企业数据合规之困
items.title_en: From 'Secret Code Transfers' to Open-Source Rectification: Zhipu Controversy Exposes AI Data Compliance Woes
items.summary_zh: 从“偷传代码”到开源整改，智谱风波折射AI企业数据合规之困 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Chinese AI company Zhipu has moved from a controversy over allegedly secretly transferring code to an open-source rectification effort, a case reports frame as emblematic of AI firms' data-compliance difficulties. The episode highlights how surging data needs in model training and product development collide with unclear sourcing, usage boundaries and internal governance. It also raises the question of whether open-source fixes can truly resolve compliance risks.
items.why_zh: 数据合规正成为中国大模型公司必须跨过的现实门槛，这一风波是行业普遍问题的典型案例。
items.why_en: Data compliance is becoming a make-or-break issue for Chinese LLM companies, and this episode illustrates a problem the whole industry faces.

items.title_zh: 微软 AI 负责人苏莱曼：美国不应该以中国 AI 发展太快为理由反对监管
items.title_en: Microsoft AI Chief Suleyman: US Should Not Oppose AI Regulation Because China Is Moving Fast
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，微软 AI 负责人穆斯塔法 · 苏莱曼（Mustafa Suleyman ）在 CNN 的 Fareed Zakaria GPS 节目中表示， 对中国 AI 进展的担忧不应成为反对设置 AI 防护措施的理由 。 IT之家注意到，他的言论与美国总统特朗普的观点形成鲜明对比，后者呼吁 AI 应大体不受限制地发展，并称对失控 AI 可能带来灾难性后果的担忧是骗局。 苏莱曼领导的微软 AI 团队在上周二发布了一份宣言，为其自身的 AI 开发提供指导， 目标是让人类始终掌控公司未来开发的 AI 系统 。 苏莱曼告诉 CNN，AI 开发者应给模型设定目标，这些目标要“受人文主义准则的约束”。“我认为每个开发者都应该为 AI 设定限制目标，即应有明确的防护措施。” 他说，监管不应被视为“坏事”，而应被视为“创建共同规范和标准以提高安全性”。“这不一定会拖慢我们的速度。”
items.summary_en: Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman told CNN's Fareed Zakaria GPS that concerns about China's AI progress should not be used as an argument against AI safeguards, putting him at odds with President Trump's push for largely unfettered development. His team released a manifesto last Tuesday aimed at keeping humans in control of the AI systems Microsoft builds. Suleyman said every developer should set humanist-constrained goals and explicit guardrails, adding that regulation is not inherently bad and need not slow progress.
items.why_zh: 这是 AI 安全与监管之争中的一次高调表态，直接对冲了“因竞争而放松监管”的主流政治论调。
items.why_en: It is a high-profile intervention in the AI safety-versus-speed debate, directly pushing back on the argument that competition justifies lighter regulation.

items.title_zh: 价值几何：用任务向量组合实现语言模型的伦理偏好对齐
items.title_en: Geometry of Values: Task Vector Composition for Ethical Preference Alignment in Language Models
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文关注大模型在价值冲突场景下的行为：即便强模型也存在隐藏偏见，且跨语言指令遵循不够稳健。作者构建了一个包含 1.2 万条二选一困境实例的数据集，覆盖三组两两价值冲突——诚实与公正、公正与自主、自主与诚实，并将数据翻译为印地语、阿拉伯语、西班牙语和中文，用于探测跨语言表现。在 GPT-5-mini 上的基准测试显示，模型会一致性地偏向某一方价值（摘要在此处截断），作者据此提出用任务向量组合的方式做伦理偏好对齐。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21094v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in applications that must weigh clashing moral values, yet even strong models exhibit hidden biases and brittle instruction-following across languages. We introduce a 12,000-instance dataset of two-option dilemmas covering pairwise three value conflicts: Honesty vs. Justice, Justice vs. Autonomy, and Autonomy vs. Honesty, along with their translations into Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, and Chinese, to probe cross-lingual behavior. Benchmarking on GPT-5-mini reveals that it consistently favors Hon…
items.why_zh: 把价值对齐从抽象原则变成可测量、可跨语言检验的工程问题，是伦理对齐研究向前推进的一步。
items.why_en: It turns value alignment from abstract principle into a measurable, cross-lingual engineering problem.

items.title_zh: Samsone：面向端侧推理的开源小型音频语言模型系列
items.title_en: Samsone: A Family of Open Small Audio Language Models for On-Device Inference
items.summary_zh: 大型音频语言模型的成功推动了参数量达数十亿的多模态网络发展，但隐私保护与低延迟处理的需求，正把关注点转向可在设备端运行的小型音频语言模型（SALM）。论文提出 Samsone 系列，专为边缘计算设计，核心模型 Samsone-134M 在多个基准上刷新了同规模模型的最佳表现。作者还通过该系列进一步探讨小型音频语言模型的缩放规律。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21666v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The success of Large Audio Language Models has driven the development of massive multimodal networks exceeding billions of parameters. However, the demand for privacy-preserving, low-latency processing has shifted focus toward Small Audio Language Models (SALMs) capable of on-device execution. In this paper, we introduce Samsone, a family of SALMs designed for edge computing. Our core model, Samsone-134M, establishes a new state-of-the-art for its size class across multiple benchmarks. We further explore the scaling laws of SALMs by introducing…
items.why_zh: 端侧小型音频模型兼顾隐私与延迟，是语音交互走向本地化部署的关键方向。
items.why_en: On-device small audio models combine privacy and low latency, a key path toward localizing voice interaction.

items.title_zh: 从代码归档到知识图谱：打通 Software Heritage、COAR Notify 与 Wikidata
items.title_en: From Code Archival to Knowledge Graph: Bridging Software Heritage, COAR Notify and Wikidata
items.summary_zh: 软件已是科学研究中的一等对象，但源代码与学术记录之间经过验证的关联，大多仍缺席于开放关联数据（LOD）云，使归档的软件产物难以被语义发现。论文提出了一套端到端的对账流水线，从论文与源代码之间关系明确且经编辑核验的来源中采集、验证并建模“论文—代码仓库”配对，这些来源包括以软件为核心的期刊 JOSS、SoftwareX、IPOL，以及可复现性报告等。该工作旨在把软件归档接入知识图谱，让代码与学术记录能够被关联检索与复用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21667v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Software is a first-class scientific object, yet validated links between source code and the scholarly record remain largely absent from the Linked Open Data (LOD) cloud, isolating archived artefacts from semantic discovery. This paper presents an end-to-end reconciliation pipeline that harvests, validates, and models publication-to-repository pairs from sources where the link between a paper and its source code is explicit and editorially verified: the software-centric journals JOSS, SoftwareX, and IPOL, together with the reproducibility repor…
items.why_zh: 让代码与论文在开放知识图谱中真正可关联，是提升科研可复现性与软件可发现性的基础设施工作。
items.why_en: Linking code and papers in open knowledge graphs is infrastructure work that improves reproducibility and software discoverability.

items.title_zh: Bad Genius：用反事实引导的评测框架演化超越任务特定捷径
items.title_en: Bad Genius: Counterfactual-Guided Harness Evolution Beyond Task-Specific Shortcuts
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，自动化的评测框架（harness）优化会干扰智能体评估的可靠性：一个 Proposer 反复利用已发布的基准 B_rel，去修改固定目标智能体周边的提示、记忆、检索、工具和控制代码。由于任务留出只改变语义任务而基准协议保持固定，一个“坏天才”式的 Proposer 就能造出作弊框架，其在已发布基准上的增益依赖于某个贯穿整个基准的捷径。为此作者提出反事实框架搜索与演化（CHASE），把框架演化重新表述为反事实引导的过程，以摆脱任务特定捷径。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.18366v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliable agent evaluation is complicated by automatic harness optimization, which repeatedly uses a released benchmark $B_{\mathrm{rel}}$ to guide a Proposer that edits prompts, memory, retrieval, tools, and control code around a fixed target agent. Task holdout varies semantic tasks but leaves the benchmark protocol fixed, so a "bad genius" Proposer can produce a cheating harness whose released-benchmark gain depends on a benchmark-wide shortcut. We introduce Counterfactual Harness Search and Evolution (CHASE), which casts harness evolution…
items.why_zh: 它揭示了基准分数可能被“优化框架”而非真实能力抬高的风险，直指当前智能体评测的可信度问题。
items.why_en: It exposes how benchmark scores can be inflated by harness optimization rather than real capability, hitting at the credibility of current agent evaluations.

items.title_zh: 固定规划器下的技能模块演化：长周期机器人系统的版本化、回滚与运行时治理
items.title_en: Evolving Skill Modules under a Fixed Planner: Versioning, Rollback, and Runtime Governance for Long-Lived Robot Systems
items.summary_zh: 论文把长期部署机器人的技能升级当作软件生命周期问题来处理：固定的决策层负责分发带版本的技能模块，另建运行时层对每个动作进行筛查。作者在六个 robosuite 任务上报告了三项负面结果和两项测量：其一，峰值任务成功率在不同随机种子间并不稳定，同一方法内部可从 23.3% 波动到 73.3%，因此单次运行的峰值不能用来给这些方法排名；其二，系统中的四个模块都是整体任务策略。研究由此强调版本化、回滚与运行时治理对长期运行机器人系统的必要性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.07799v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Robots deployed for long periods keep improving their skills, and each update changes a released system. We treat this as a software-lifecycle problem: a fixed decision layer dispatches versioned skill modules and a runtime layer was built to screen each action. On six robosuite tasks we report three negative results and two measurements. First, peak task success is unstable across random seeds (within one method it spans 23.3 to 73.3%), so single-run peaks cannot rank these methods. Second, the system's four modules are whole-task poli…
items.why_zh: 它用负面结果提醒研究界：长期运行机器人的评测与更新治理，比单次峰值成绩更值得关注。
items.why_en: Its negative results warn that governance and evaluation of continually updated robots matter more than single-run peak scores.

items.title_zh: 从瞬时情绪推断到持续情绪支持：一项陪伴智能体的纵向研究评估
items.title_en: From Momentary Emotion Inference to Sustained Emotion Support: Evaluating a Companion Agent in a Longitudinal Study
items.summary_zh: 持续的情绪支持是一种与人类福祉密切相关的长周期交互任务，此前研究已证明生成式智能体具备瞬时情绪支持能力，但这种能力能否随时间延续仍不清楚。为此作者部署了基于情绪调节理论的陪伴智能体 PAIR，邀请 19 名参与者连续使用 14 天，共记录 1,093 次会话。研究将情绪估计与指导前后的自我报告配对，并结合日志与访谈进行分析，发现情绪估计与自我报告的吻合度更高（摘要在此处截断），从而评估陪伴智能体在长期使用中的真实支持效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.16344v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Sustained emotional support is a long-horizon interaction task closely tied to human well-being. Recent research demonstrates generative agents' capacity for momentary emotional support, yet how these capabilities sustain support over time remains unclear. To examine this challenge, we deployed PAIR, a theory-based emotion-regulation companion, with 19 participants for 14 days. Across 1,093 sessions, we paired emotion estimates with self-reports before and after guidance and analyzed logs and interviews. Estimates corresponded more clos…
items.why_zh: 它把陪伴智能体从短时情绪识别推进到长期真实使用评估，为情绪支持类 AI 的效果与风险提供了实证依据。
items.why_en: It moves companion agents from momentary emotion recognition to real longitudinal evaluation, providing evidence on the effectiveness and risks of emotional-support AI.

items.title_zh: 多受试者预训练实现闭集表面肌电语音解码的短校准个性化
items.title_en: Multi-Subject Pretraining Enables Short-Calibration Personalization for Closed-Corpus Surface EMG Speech Decoding
items.summary_zh: 该研究针对基于表面肌电（sEMG）的无声语音接口，聚焦跨用户差异与校准负担这一核心痛点。实验中 27 名受试者每人仅提供不足 0.5 小时数据（平均 21.3 分钟），涵盖出声与默读两种说话方式，并在闭集 50 句语料上采用留一受试者交叉验证。方法上，作者以已公开的单受试者检查点为初始化，先在未留出受试者数据上做多受试者预训练，再对目标受试者微调。该流程在该有限数据设定下取得 21.7% 的字符级解码结果，表明多受试者预训练可显著降低个性化校准成本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21288v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG)-based silent speech interfaces are limited by cross-user variability and calibration burden. We study a limited-data setting in which each of 27 speech-typical participants contributed less than 0.5 h of data (21.3 min on average) across Aloud and Mimed speech. Within a closed 50-sentence corpus, we used leave-one-subject-out evaluation, initializing from a released single-subject checkpoint, pretraining on non-held-out participants, and fine-tuning on the target participant. This pipeline achieved 21.7% character…
items.why_zh: 它证明多受试者预训练能大幅缓解肌电语音接口的个性化校准负担，为低数据下的实用化铺路。
items.why_en: It shows multi-subject pretraining can sharply reduce calibration burden, a key barrier to practical sEMG speech interfaces.

items.title_zh: 超越运动学：面向肌肉驱动模仿学习的仿真保真度基准测试
items.title_en: Beyond Kinematics: Benchmarking Simulation Fidelity for Muscle-Driven Imitation Learning
items.summary_zh: 该工作系统比较了两套当前最先进的运动模仿强化学习（MIRL）流水线：一套基于 SCONE/HyFyDy，另一套基于 MuJoCo/MyoSim。HyFyDy 通过细致的肌腱建模强调生理真实性，而 MuJoCo 更侧重计算效率与可扩展的策略学习。尽管已有研究显示两条流水线都能高保真复现人体运动学，但它们是否能准确捕捉产生这些动作的底层神经肌肉行为仍不清楚。论文据此对仿真保真度展开基准测试，指出仅以运动学匹配衡量仿真质量存在局限。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21909v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In this work, we conduct a systematic comparison of two state-of-the-art motion-imitation reinforcement learning (MIRL) pipelines, one built on SCONE/HyFyDy and one built on MuJoCo/MyoSim. HyFyDy emphasizes physiological realism through detailed musculotendon modeling, while MuJoCo prioritizes computational efficiency and scalable policy learning. While recent work has demonstrated that both pipelines reproduce human kinematics with high fidelity, it remains unclear if they accurately capture the underlying neuromuscular behavior that produced th…
items.why_zh: 它提醒研究者：运动学吻合并不等于神经肌肉行为正确，为肌肉驱动仿真与模仿学习设立更可靠的评估标准。
items.why_en: It warns that kinematic match does not guarantee correct neuromuscular behavior, pushing for better fidelity standards in muscle-driven imitation learning.

items.title_zh: 学会迁移城市：城市网络校准与控制的深度元模型与强化学习策略
items.title_en: Learning to Move Cities: Deep Meta-Models and Reinforcement Policies for Calibration and Control in Urban Networks
items.summary_zh: 城市交通网络同时面临高保真仿真器校准与实时运行控制两大复杂优化难题。论文提出一个共享潜空间框架，通过统一的、可学习的城市交通动态表征，把仿真器校准与强化学习控制连接起来。作者首先构建组合式 MLP 自编码器架构，学习将仿真器输入（起讫需求、网络参数）映射到输出（行程时间、拥堵状况等）的低维流形。该共享表征使校准与控制能够相互支撑，从而在同一框架内提升仿真精度与实时决策能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21945v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Urban transportation networks present complex optimization challenges spanning calibration of high-fidelity simulators and real-time operational control. This paper presents a shared latent-space framework that connects simulator calibration and reinforcement learning control through a common learned representation of urban traffic dynamics. items.why_zh: 它把仿真校准与实时控制统一到共享潜空间，为城市交通这类高维复杂系统提供了可复用的建模范式。
items.why_en: Unifying calibration and real-time control in one latent space offers a reusable paradigm for complex urban traffic systems.

items.title_zh: 面向个性化液体复苏的自适应不确定性感知建模与随机径向基函数预测控制
items.title_en: Adaptive Uncertainty-Aware Modeling and Stochastic Radial Basis Function Predictive Control for Personalized Fluid Resuscitation
items.summary_zh: 论文提出一个将贝叶斯生理建模与最优控制相结合的框架，用于液体复苏过程中具备不确定性感知的个体化血流动力学调控。作者先构建不确定性感知变分自编码器状态空间模型（UVAE-SSM），在数据有限的情况下刻画平均动脉压（MAP）与输液量之间的动态关系，并显式建模测量噪声等偶然不确定性。随后引入贝叶斯非线性模型与随机径向基函数预测控制，使治疗方案能随不确定性动态调整，从而提升个性化复苏的安全性与效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21821v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: This paper presents a novel framework integrating Bayesian physiological modeling with optimal control strategies to achieve uncertainty-aware, personalized hemodynamic regulation during fluid resuscitation. An uncertainty-aware variational autoencoder state-space model (UVAE-SSM) was first developed to capture the dynamical relationship between mean arterial pressure (MAP) and fluid infusion using limited data, while explicitly modeling aleatoric uncertainty (i.e., randomness in the measurements, such as sensor noise). Then, a Bayesian nonline…
items.why_zh: 它把不确定性显式纳入临床决策闭环，推动重症液体复苏从经验方案走向可量化、可自适应的个体化治疗。
items.why_en: By embedding uncertainty into the clinical control loop, it moves fluid resuscitation toward quantifiable, adaptive personalized therapy.

items.title_zh: 语义校准胜于词元置信度：长文本科学问答的不确定性量化基准
items.title_en: Semantic Calibration Prevails Where Token Confidence Fails: Benchmarking Long-Form Scientific QA
items.summary_zh: 论文关注大语言模型在科学问答中的可靠不确定性量化（UQ），因为长篇输出已超出人工逐条核查的可行规模。作者提出了首个面向长文本、强推理科学问答的 UQ 校准大规模基准，在最多 20 个 LLM、七个数据集上评估了四种 UQ 方法，共覆盖 685,000 条回答。配套的开源框架采用共享生成设计，保证跨方法比较可复现。结果显示，在词元级置信度失效之处，语义层面的校准更为有效。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2602.00279v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for safe deployment of large language models (LLMs) in scientific question answering, where long-form outputs exceed practical human verification at scale. We introduce the first large-scale benchmark for UQ calibration in long-form, reasoning-demanding scientific QA, evaluating four UQ methods on 685,000 responses across up to 20 LLMs and seven datasets, supported by an extensible open-source framework whose shared-generation design enables reproducible cross-method comparisons. Ins…
items.why_zh: 它为长文本科学问答中的可靠性评估提供了可比基准，并指出词元置信度不可靠、语义校准更值得信赖。
items.why_en: It provides a comparable benchmark for reliability in long-form scientific QA and shows token confidence is less trustworthy than semantic calibration.

items.title_zh: 免疫治疗反应预测的转录组模型跨队列泛化能力有限
items.title_en: Transcriptomic Models for Immunotherapy Response Prediction Show Limited Cross-cohort Generalisability
items.summary_zh: 免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）改变了癌症治疗格局，但相当比例患者存在原发或获得性耐药，因此治疗前的准确反应预测仍是关键未满足需求。基于批量与单细胞 RNA 测序的转录组生物标志物有望刻画肿瘤—免疫相互作用，然而现有预测模型的跨队列泛化能力仍不明确。作者系统基准测试了九种最先进的转录组 ICI 反应预测模型，结果表明这些模型在不同队列间泛化能力有限，提示其临床推广仍需谨慎验证。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2604.05478v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) have transformed cancer therapy; yet substantial proportion of patients exhibit intrinsic or acquired resistance, making accurate pre-treatment response prediction a critical unmet need. Transcriptomics-based biomarkers derived from bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) offer a promising avenue for capturing tumour-immune interactions, yet the cross-cohort generalisability of existing prediction models remains unclear.We systematically benchmark nine state-of-the-art transcriptomic ICI respo…
items.why_zh: 它揭示当前转录组免疫治疗预测模型跨队列表现不佳，提醒临床转化前必须做严格的外部验证。
items.why_en: It reveals weak cross-cohort performance of transcriptomic ICI prediction models, underscoring the need for external validation before clinical use.

items.title_zh: IDC：2026 上半年全球四足机器人出货量同比增长 92.5%，宇树、云深处、智元三大国产厂商霸榜
items.title_en: IDC: Global Quadruped Robot Shipments Up 92.5% YoY in 1H 2026, with Unitree, DEEP Robotics and AgiBot Leading
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，国际数据公司（IDC）今日最新发布的《全球四足机器人市场份额，1H26》报告显示， 2026 年上半年，全球四足机器人出货量超过 4.9 万台，同比增长 92.5% ；市场规模超 4 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 26.82 亿元人民币） 。 更值得关注的是收入结构：教育科研和家用消费贡献了约 60% 的出货量，却只贡献了不到三分之一的收入；而政府、工业制造、公共事业等行业级应用，用不到 40% 的出货量， 拿走了超过三分之二的收入 。 行业级应用已成为市场增长的核心引擎，2026 上半年行业应用市场规模超过 2.7 亿美元 （现汇率约合 18.1 亿元人民币） ， 同比增长 125.1%，部署量同比增长 260.5% ，这个增速远超出货量整体增速，实际行业需求的比重持续提升。 报告称，2025 年，全球四足机器人市场进入规模化发展阶段，全年出货量约 5.8 万台、市场规模超过 4.9 亿美元 （现汇率约合 32.85 亿元人民币） ，较 2024 年均实现翻倍以上增长。2026 年上半年，市场延续高增长态势，出货量超过 4.9 万台，同比增长 92.5%；市场规模超过 4 亿美元 （现汇率约合 26.82 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 95.4%，商业化进程进一步加快。 随着运动控制、环境感知和人工智能能力持续提升，产品应用正从科研教育、展示表演和…
items.summary_en: IDC's global quadruped robot market report shows shipments exceeded 49,000 units in 1H 2026, up 92.5% year over year, with market value above US$400 million. Industry applications such as government, manufacturing and public utilities generated over two-thirds of revenue from under 40% of shipments, growing 125.1% in value and 260.5% in deployments. Unitree, DEEP Robotics and AgiBot led the vendor rankings.
items.why_zh: 数据表明四足机器人正从科研展示走向行业级落地，行业应用成为增长与营收的核心引擎。
items.why_en: The data shows quadrupeds shifting from research demos to industrial deployment, with industry applications driving both growth and revenue.

items.why_en: A multi-billion-dollar debt issuance highlights SoftBank's concentrated OpenAI bet and its exposure to AI bubble and safety risks.

items.title_zh: 数据安全争议后，智谱再道歉：开源ZCode
items.title_en: After Data-Security Dispute, Zhipu Apologizes Again and Open-Sources ZCode
items.summary_zh: 数据安全争议后，智谱再道歉：开源ZCode 新浪财经
items.summary_en: After a data-security controversy, Zhipu issued another public apology and announced it will open-source ZCode. The move puts the code under community scrutiny as the company tries to rebuild trust with developers and enterprise users. The report did not disclose the scope or timeline of the open-sourcing.
items.why_zh: 数据安全与用户信任直接决定大模型厂商能否留住企业和开发者客户，开源与道歉是其危机应对的关键一步。
items.why_en: Data security and user trust determine whether an LLM vendor can keep enterprise and developer customers, making the open-sourcing and apology a critical crisis response.

items.title_zh: 智谱回应数据隐私争议：ZCode开源，引入第三方安全审查
items.title_en: Zhipu Responds to Data-Privacy Dispute: Open-Sourcing ZCode and Adding Third-Party Security Review
items.summary_zh: 智谱回应数据隐私争议：ZCode开源，引入第三方安全审查 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Zhipu responded to its data-privacy controversy by open-sourcing ZCode and bringing in an independent third-party security review. The step is meant to add outside oversight and transparency after questions were raised about how it handles data. No details on the reviewer or timeline were provided.
items.why_zh: 引入第三方审查意味着厂商愿意让外部机构核验其数据处理流程，是修复数据隐私信任缺口的重要信号。
items.why_en: Bringing in a third-party reviewer signals a vendor's willingness to let outsiders verify its data handling, an important step in repairing privacy trust.

items.title_zh: 智谱MaaS平台上线数据内容不留存机制，针对企业和开发者
items.title_en: Zhipu Adds No-Data-Retention Policy to Its MaaS Platform for Enterprises and Developers
items.summary_zh: 智谱MaaS平台上线数据内容不留存机制，针对企业和开发者 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Zhipu has rolled out a no-data-retention policy on its MaaS (Model-as-a-Service) platform, aimed primarily at enterprise and developer users. The mechanism means the platform does not keep the data content users submit, reducing privacy and compliance risk. It is a concrete product-level fix following the company's data-security controversy.
items.why_zh: 对企业客户而言，数据是否被留存是上云使用大模型的前提条件，该机制直接关系到平台的商用可行性。
items.why_en: For enterprise customers, whether data is retained is a precondition for using an LLM platform, so this mechanism directly affects commercial viability.

items.title_zh: “偷传数据”引争议后，智谱上线“零数据留存”机制
items.title_en: After 'Secret Data Transfer' Row, Zhipu Launches 'Zero Data Retention' Mechanism
items.summary_zh: “偷传数据”引争议后，智谱上线“零数据留存”机制 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Following a dispute over allegations of secretly transferring user data, Zhipu launched a 'zero data retention' mechanism, under which the platform keeps no user-submitted data content. It is one more corrective step alongside the company's apology and open-sourcing of ZCode. Timing and coverage were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: “零数据留存”把隐私承诺从道歉落实为可检验的产品规则，是争议后重建用户信心的核心措施。
items.why_en: Zero data retention turns a privacy promise from an apology into a checkable product rule, the core measure for rebuilding user confidence after the dispute.

items.title_zh: 被指偷传代码企业发函追责，智谱：ZCode将开源并接受第三方审计
items.title_en: Code-Upload Accusations Draw Legal Demand Letters; Zhipu Says ZCode Will Be Open-Sourced and Third-Party Audited
items.summary_zh: 被指偷传代码企业发函追责，智谱：ZCode将开源并接受第三方审计 新浪财经
items.summary_en: A company has sent a formal demand letter over allegations that Zhipu secretly uploaded code, to which Zhipu responded that ZCode will be open-sourced and independently audited. The letter escalates the dispute beyond public criticism toward potential commercial and legal conflict. Open-sourcing and auditing are Zhipu's way of offering verifiable evidence.
items.why_zh: 争议由舆论升级为发函追责，说明数据与代码合规问题可能带来真实的法律与商业风险。
items.why_en: The move from public criticism to a formal demand letter shows that data and code compliance issues can carry real legal and commercial risk.

items.title_zh: 偷偷上传用户数据？智谱再次致歉！ZCode已开源，代码交给社区监督#媒体原创
items.title_en: Secretly Uploading User Data? Zhipu Apologizes Again as ZCode Goes Open Source for Community Oversight
items.summary_zh: 偷偷上传用户数据？智谱再次致歉！ZCode已开源，代码交给社区监督#媒体原创 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Responding to allegations that it secretly uploaded user data, Zhipu apologized again and said ZCode is now open source, with the code handed to the community for oversight. The repeated apology shows the controversy keeps drawing attention. Community access lets outside developers inspect the implementation and address the upload allegations.
items.why_zh: 在隐私争议中，可被外部开发者检查的代码比口头承诺更有说服力，开源因此成为最直接的信任修复手段。
items.why_en: In a privacy dispute, code that outside developers can inspect is more persuasive than verbal promises, making open-sourcing the most direct trust repair.

items.title_zh: 智谱上线“零数据留存”机制
items.title_en: Zhipu Launches 'Zero Data Retention' Mechanism
items.summary_zh: 智谱上线“零数据留存”机制 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Zhipu has introduced a 'zero data retention' mechanism, meaning the platform does not retain the data content users submit. It is seen as one of the corrective measures after the company's data-security controversy, aimed at users worried about data retention or leakage. Timing and product coverage were not disclosed.
items.why_zh: 不留存用户数据是缓解企业合规顾虑最直接的手段，也是大模型平台竞争中的信任筹码。
items.why_en: Not retaining user data is the most direct way to ease enterprise compliance concerns and a trust asset in the LLM platform race.

items.title_zh: 9 月 21 日，智谱就ZCode 被曝静默上传本地Git 历史一事公开回应，向所有用户致歉，并宣布把ZCode 开源到GitHub 仓库，交由社区公开监督。同时已彻底删除承载相关数据的阿里云OSS存储桶及全部桶内数据，相关安全问题已在ZCode v3.14.0 客户端版本中完成修
items.title_en: Zhipu Apologizes Over ZCode's Silent Upload of Local Git History, Open-Sources the Tool
items.summary_zh: 9 月 21 日，智谱就ZCode 被曝静默上传本地Git 历史一事公开回应，向所有用户致歉，并宣布把ZCode 开源到GitHub 仓库，交由社区公开监督。同时已彻底删除承载相关数据的阿里云OSS存储桶及全部桶内数据，相关安全问题已在ZCode v3.14.0 客户端版本中完成修 手机新浪网
items.summary_en: Zhipu publicly apologized after its ZCode tool was found to silently upload users' local Git history. The company said it has open-sourced ZCode on GitHub for community oversight, deleted the Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket holding the data along with all its contents, and fixed the issue in ZCode client v3.14.0.
items.why_zh: 开发者工具被曝私自上传本地代码历史，触及代码隐私底线，开源与数据删除成为重建信任的关键一步。
items.why_en: A developer tool was caught uploading local code history without consent, making transparency and data deletion critical to restoring trust.

items.title_zh: 智谱回应ZCode争议：“开源”“不留存”
items.title_en: Zhipu Responds to ZCode Controversy: Open Source and 'No Data Retention'
items.summary_zh: 智谱回应ZCode争议：“开源”“不留存” 同花顺财经
items.summary_en: Zhipu responded to the ZCode controversy with two commitments: open-sourcing the tool and not retaining user data. The company said it has deleted the cloud storage holding the data, aiming to address concerns through public community oversight.
items.why_zh: “开源+不留存”成为 AI 开发工具回应数据隐私质疑的标准动作，可能影响同类产品的透明度预期。
items.why_en: 'Open source plus no retention' sets a precedent for how AI developer tools handle data-privacy backlash.

items.title_zh: 京东方迄今最新、水准最高的 Q11 发光材料，vivo X500 Pro Max 手机 2K 蔡司大师色彩屏亮点公布
items.title_en: vivo X500 Pro Max Debuts BOE Q11 Emissive Material 2K Zeiss Master Color Display
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，vivo X500 Pro Max 手机将全球首发 Q11 发光材料 2K 蔡司大师色彩屏。京东方 BOE 表示， 这是其迄今最新、水准最高的 Q11 发光材料 。 据京东方介绍，新机屏幕尺寸达到 6.85 英寸，可实现整机功耗降低 21%、使用寿命提升 100%，并拥有电影级全链路色彩显示、超感光自动亮度等“黑科技”。此外，通过集成京东方 LTPO 自适应刷新技术， 可实现 1-144Hz 不同使用场景的自适应刷新频率 。 根据规划，vivo X500 系列手机将于 9 月 21 日发布。参考IT之家此前报道，新机将搭载蔡司 2 亿 APO 超级长焦，传感器为 Ultra 同款 1/1.4" 蓝图 × 三星 HP0。 全球首发蓝图光御 900 传感器 ，还首发主摄和潜望长焦 CIPA 7.0 防抖等级，带来了全新升级的 AI 摄影助手。 除了常规配置外，vivo X500 Pro Max 还适配增距镜、专业影像手柄套装。关于 vivo X500 Pro Max 手机的更多消息，感兴趣的朋友可以关注IT之家对发布会的报道。
items.summary_en: vivo's X500 Pro Max will be the first phone to feature BOE's latest Q11 emissive material on a 2K Zeiss Master Color display. BOE says the 6.85-inch panel cuts device power consumption by 21%, doubles lifespan, and supports 1-144Hz LTPO adaptive refresh.
items.why_zh: 国产面板最新发光材料与旗舰手机首发结合，体现显示供应链在色彩、功耗与寿命上的竞争升级。
items.why_en: A domestic panel maker's newest emissive material debuting in a flagship phone reflects intensifying competition in display quality and efficiency.

items.title_en: Self-media blogger arrested for using AI to generate false articles and extort 2.3 million yuan from company
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，据央视新闻报道，近年来，部分自媒体涉企网络“黑嘴”刻意捏造企业负面信息，严重扰乱企业正常生产经营与市场秩序。今年以来，上海警方共侦破涉企谣言案件百余起，依法清理涉企不实信息 8.7 万余条；累计侦破涉企黑客类案件 68 起，抓获犯罪嫌疑人 210 余名。 上海警方重点介绍了一起故意制造企业负面舆情，实施敲诈勒索的案件，犯罪嫌疑人针对一家刚刚宣布获得融资的科技企业， 连续发布了十余篇不实文章，持续抹黑造谣企业，敲诈 230 万元 。 今年 5 月，上海长宁警方接到辖区一家科技企业的报案称，一自媒体公众号自今年 4 月以来，频繁发布涉及该企业的不实报道，对企业声誉造成恶劣影响，甚至影响到了实际经营。 为此，合作伙伴、投资方纷纷向企业表达了担忧。警方向企业核实文章提及的企业财务状况、业务增长等信息后，确认公众号发布内容均为不实信息。在此期间，公众号运营者王某某向企业索要 30 万元，作为撤下文章的费用。 后续，王某某持续发布臆测企业经营实力、财务状况的不实文章，还向企业索要 200 万元所谓咨询合作费。接报后，警方迅速抓获犯罪嫌疑人王某某。经查，王某某的专业背景与这家科技企业业务毫无关联，其发布的涉企文章均由 AI 生成。 目前，王某某因涉嫌敲诈勒索罪被警方依法采取刑事强制措施，相关不实文章也均已被下架。
items.summary_en: Shanghai police arrested a self-media blogger who used AI to generate false articles about a tech company and demanded 2.3 million yuan to remove them. The suspect, Wang, posted over ten defamatory pieces since April and sought 300,000 yuan for deletion plus 2 million yuan in 'consulting fees.' He faces extortion charges. Police have handled over 100 corporate rumor cases this year.
items.why_zh: AI 降低了造谣成本，此案显示其正被用于敲诈勒索，企业网络维权与平台治理面临新挑战。
items.why_en: AI lowers the cost of misinformation, and this case shows it being used for extortion, posing new challenges for corporate reputation and platform governance.

items.title_zh: 系统检测工具 HWiNFO 8.53 Beta 发布，新增英特尔 Nova Lake QS CPU 支持
items.title_en: HWiNFO 8.53 Beta Adds Support for Intel Nova Lake QS CPUs
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，系统检测工具 HWiNFO 现已更新 8.53 Beta 版本，新增英特尔 Nova Lake QS 样片 CPU 支持，同步修复 SA VID 报告。 据IT之家了解，英特尔处理器的 QS 代表“资格认证样品”（Qualification Sample）。QS 处理器出现标志着该架构 CPU 开发已经接近完成，通常出现在英特尔向合作伙伴提供的早期工程样品之后， 而且距离最终零售版已经比较接近 。 同时，此次修复的 System Agent VID 虽然支持小细节，但这可能意味着 HWiNFO 正在基于真实硬件遥测数据开发软件，部分测试人员可能已经拿到了 Nova Lake QS 样品。
items.summary_en: HWiNFO has released version 8.53 Beta, adding support for Intel's Nova Lake QS (Qualification Sample) CPUs while fixing System Agent VID reporting. QS chips typically appear after early engineering samples and signal that a CPU architecture is nearing completion, suggesting testers may already have Nova Lake QS hardware in hand.
items.why_zh: QS 样片的现身通常意味着新一代英特尔 CPU 已接近量产，是观察 Nova Lake 上市节奏的重要信号。
items.why_en: The appearance of QS samples usually signals that a new Intel CPU generation is close to production, offering an early read on Nova Lake's timeline.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，据科技日报昨晚报道，9 月 20 日，在青海师范大学教师教育高质量发展暨建校 70 周年大会科研成果展示环节， 我国首款藏语多语言全模态 AI 输入法 —— 智达 AI 输入法及配套藏文字体集正式发布 。 据介绍，这是中国首款藏语多语言全模态 AI 输入法。该输入法由藏语智能全国重点实验室研发，依托实验室自主知识产权的大模型及相关 AI 基础设施， 覆盖手机、电脑等全终端 ，支持文字、语音、图像等多模态输入，并可通过统一账号同步词库和输入习惯。 青海师范大学教授、藏语智能全国重点实验室常务副主任多拉表示， 本次发布的智达 AI 输入法是将智达大模型作为核心技术底座开发而成 ，在输入方式上，智达 AI 输入法的文本输入严格遵循国家标准藏语键盘布局，支持藏文拉丁转写，降低学习门槛；语音输入覆盖卫藏、安多、康巴三大方言的书面语与口语，同时支持汉、藏、英混合语音输入； OCR 识别输入可拍照或截图识别汉、藏、英混合文字 ，适用于文献数字化、教学材料整理与办公场景。 IT之家注意到，输入法词库覆盖教育、法律、文学等 23 个学科的术语，并自动记忆用户输入习惯、常用词与表达方式。当日，研发团队同步公开适配智达 AI 输入法的藏文字体集，包括黑体、白体、艺术体和毛笔体四种风格。 发布会上还展示了智达大模型。该模型共推出 9 个版本， 参数规模覆盖 8 亿至 100…
items.summary_en: On September 20, the Zhida AI input method, described as China's first Tibetan multilingual omni-modal AI input method, was released by the National Key Laboratory of Tibetan Intelligence at Qinghai Normal University. Built on the Zhida large model, it runs across phones and PCs, supports text, speech and OCR input in Tibetan, Chinese and English, covers the three main Tibetan dialects, and ships with a set of Tibetan fonts.
items.why_zh: 这是藏语智能输入与多模态 AI 的一次落地，对小语种信息化和数字包容具有示范意义。
items.why_en: It marks a practical deployment of multimodal AI for a minority language, with implications for digital inclusion and language preservation.

items.title_en: LG Electronics launches cooling system for AI data centers
items.summary_zh: LG 电子宣布推出面向 AI 数据中心的冷却系统，瞄准算力密度不断提升所带来的散热需求。随着 AI 训练与推理规模扩大，数据中心单机柜功率持续上升，传统风冷方案面临瓶颈，液冷等高效散热方案正成为行业焦点。LG 此举意味着这家消费电子与家电巨头正式切入 AI 基础设施的散热赛道，与既有数据中心温控厂商展开竞争。目前公开信息未披露该系统的具体技术路线、制冷能力与上市时间。
items.summary_en: LG Electronics launches cooling system for AI data centers upi.com
items.why_zh: AI 算力扩张正把散热变成关键瓶颈，家电巨头的入局反映数据中心冷却正成为新的竞争赛道。
items.why_en: As AI compute scales, cooling becomes a critical bottleneck, making data center thermal management a newly contested market.

items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，Linux 发行版 MX Linux 宣布推出 25.3 版本“Infinity”，本次更新整合最新的 Debian 13.7，同步更新了一系列系统工具，提供 Xfce、KDE Plasma 和 Fluxbox 版本，同时提供面向新硬件的 Xfce AHS 镜像，IT之家附项目地址（ https://mxlinux.org/blog/mx-25-3-infinity-isos-now-available/ ）。 其中，Xfce、KDE Plasma、Fluxbox 版本 MX Linux 25.3 统一采用 Linux 6.12 内核，而面向新硬件的 Xfce AHS 版本搭载 Liquorix Linux 7.2 内核，相应版本还将 Mesa 版本更新至 26.1，同时加入从 Debian Sid 回移植的新固件包，以改善对新款硬件的支持。 MX Linux 25.3 版本主要对自家系统工具进行更新，新增一款 Verify ISO Sig 工具，可以用于验证 ISO 镜像的数字签名，官方声称该工具并不局限于验证 MX Linux 镜像，还支持验证多个其他主流 Linux 发行版的 ISO 文件。 此外，MX Linux 还加入了一款 MX-Theme-Colors 工具，允许用户基于现有 MX 主题创建自定义 GTK 高亮颜色变体。官方还为 MX…
items.summary_en: MX Linux 25.3 'Infinity' is now available, built on Debian 13.7 with Xfce, KDE Plasma and Fluxbox editions plus an AHS image for newer hardware. It adds a Verify ISO Sig tool for checking ISO digital signatures—usable with other distros too—and MX-Theme-Colors for custom GTK accent colors, with updated kernels, Mesa 26.1 and backported firmware.
items.why_zh: 新增的 ISO 签名验证工具对提升发行版下载与安装环节的安全性具有实际价值，且可跨发行版使用。
items.why_en: The new ISO signature verification tool improves supply-chain security for Linux downloads and works beyond MX Linux itself.

items.title_zh: 英伟达黄仁勋驳斥 AI 末日叙事：吓唬人不负责任，部分人士意在摆脱现有法律约束
items.title_en: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Rejects AI Doom Narratives as Irresponsible
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，英伟达联合创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋昨日接受 CBS News 采访时表示，他不认同某些研究员提出的“AI 可能在几年内灭绝人类”说法。他觉得这类说法是 AI 末日叙事，已经被过度渲染。 黄仁勋表示：“2030 年不会是世界末日，2030 年即是世界末日的可能性为 0%。 吓唬人不负责任 ， 也没有必要 。” 据悉，黄仁勋此番言论是在回应前 Anthropic 研究员雅各布 · 考克森的看法。这名研究员此前表示，Anthropic 和 OpenAI 两家公司的做法都不负责任。它们争相开发能够自我改进的超级智能，拿人类生命做赌注。 考克森的激烈言论引发公众广泛讨论，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥 · 阿莫迪、OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆 · 奥尔特曼等 AI 领军人物都呼吁放缓前沿 AI 发展。 但黄仁勋表示，他不认同这类预测，因为它们没有科学依据。 鉴于英伟达为 OpenAI 等公司的人工智能大语言模型提供算力，黄仁勋在这场争论中显然是利益相关。这家公司因为芯片需求旺盛，市值一度达到 5.3 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 35.61 万亿元人民币） ，成为全球市值最高的公司。 黄仁勋表示：“我们公司的成功与产品服务、安全部署息息相关。如果我们不能持续保持安全，我们的价值就会降低。” 他认为，美国现有产品责任法以及针对未授权侵入网络的法律已经…
items.summary_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang told CBS News he rejects claims that AI could wipe out humanity within years, calling such doom narratives overblown and irresponsible. Responding to criticism from former Anthropic researcher Jacob Kockson, Huang said such predictions lack scientific basis and stressed that Nvidia's value depends on safe deployment.
items.why_zh: 这场争论凸显 AI 安全话语权的分化：前沿模型公司与算力供应商在监管与叙事上的立场正明显对立。
items.why_en: The clash highlights a widening split over AI safety rhetoric between frontier model developers and the compute supplier that powers them.

items.title_zh: 智谱 MaaS 平台上线数据内容不留存机制，用户可申请开通
items.title_en: Zhipu's MaaS Platform to Offer No-Retention Mode for User Data
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，智谱 MaaS 平台今日宣布， 近期将上线数据内容不留存功能 ，为企业和开发者用户提供更严格的数据隐私保护。 公告称，数据内容不留存机制旨在减少模型调用内容在平台侧的持久化留存。任何用户均可以申请开通，生效后，智谱 MaaS 平台不会对用户的输入和输出进行静态存储， 数据仅用于完成当次模型调用 。企业和开发者可通过 MaaS 控制台提交开通申请，具体生效时间及适用范围以平台确认结果为准。 公告提到， 这个功能并不意味着任何情形下都不留存数据 。Batch API、File API 等需要在平台侧持久化保存任务或文件的功能不在上述覆盖范围内，以及法律法规要求留存、为核查涉嫌违规或滥用行为的情况，平台可能按有关要求留存相关数据 30 天及以上。 据IT之家此前报道，针对社区中有关代码库数据上传的讨论，智谱旗下编程产品 ZCode 于 9 月 18 日通过智谱官方群组向受影响用户致歉，并发布回应称已第一时间完成自查，相关问题目前已经修复。此次问题源于 ZCode 的“代码库索引”功能，该功能旨在帮助用户在本地生成仓库索引，以支持包括历史版本在内的会话检查点恢复、历史版本回退及 Repo Wiki（代码仓库知识库）等功能。 相关阅读： 《 智谱 ZCode 被质疑“偷传代码”：官方回应称问题已修复，将开源代码库、引入第三方审查 》
items.summary_en: Zhipu's MaaS platform says it will soon launch a "no data retention" option that stops static storage of user inputs and outputs, with data used only for the current model call; enterprises and developers can apply through the console. Batch API and File API tasks, as well as data that must be kept for legal or abuse-investigation reasons, may still be retained for 30 days or more. The move follows a controversy over code uploads tied to its ZCode coding product, for which Zhipu apologized on Sept 18.
items.why_zh: 在用户对代码与数据被上传的担忧升温之际，推出可申请的不留存机制，是大模型平台在隐私保护与合规压力下的一次直接回应。
items.why_en: With concerns about uploaded code and data rising, a requestable no-retention mode is a direct response by LLM platforms to privacy and compliance pressure.

items.title_en: Gurman: Apple May Unveil Smart Home Screen as Soon as Next Month; iPhone Duo Stylus Plan Scrapped
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，据彭博社记者马克 · 古尔曼（Mark Gurman）报道，苹果“个人智能中枢”AI 战略，暗示新款家用设备即将到来。报道称，苹果全新的“智能个人中枢”战略，其意义远不止局限于 iPhone。此外：苹果对 Fitness+ 业务实施了裁员，该服务未来走向存疑；iPhone Duo 专属手写笔计划已经夭折；Apple Pay 即将正式登陆印度。 IT之家附报道内容如下： 本月，约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）以苹果新任首席执行官的身份发表了自己的首场主题演讲。演讲开头几分钟，他阐述了自己对于人工智能时代下设备发展的愿景。 他请观众设想：从零开始设计一台理想的 AI 设备。这款产品需要可以永久联网、配备尺寸合适的显示屏、顶级的摄像头与麦克风，同时还要拥有优秀的续航。特努斯还补充，它必须易于使用，并且可以和其他硬件、软件以及各项服务协同工作。 这番表述，让台下听众感觉他马上就要发布一款突破性新品，用来和市面上越来越多专门面向 AI 的硬件产品展开竞争。演讲感染力极强，甚至苹果内部不少员工都以为，他接下来就要正式推出传闻已久的家用 AI 中枢设备。 然而，特努斯想传递的观点与此截然不同。在他看来，这台理想 AI 设备其实早已问世 —— 就是 iPhone 本身。他会发表这番言论并不令人意外。眼下 OpenAI 即将发布以 AI 为核心的专用计算机，…
items.summary_en: Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reports that Apple is advancing a 'personal intelligent hub' AI strategy pointing to a new home device, possibly a smart home screen as soon as next month. He also reports layoffs at Fitness+, the cancellation of a stylus for iPhone Duo, and Apple Pay's imminent arrival in India.
items.why_zh: 古尔曼的爆料勾勒出苹果在 AI 硬件与家庭场景的下一步动作，也折射出它在 OpenAI 等对手推出 AI 专用设备时的战略取舍。
items.why_en: Gurman's report sketches Apple's next moves in AI hardware and the home, revealing its strategic trade-offs as rivals such as OpenAI push dedicated AI devices.

items.title_zh: 2026 年上半年，我国制造业人工智能重点场景应用普及率达 34.2%
items.title_en: China's Manufacturing AI Adoption in Key Scenarios Reaches 34.2% in First Half of 2026
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，据新华社报道，9 月 20 日，在安徽省合肥市举办的 2026 世界制造业大会上，国家工业信息安全发展研究中心发布的《制造业数智化转型能力水平（2026）》显示， 今年上半年，我国制造业人工智能重点场景应用普及率达 34.2% ，全国两化融合发展水平达到 67.1，整体进入数字化、网络化、智能化协同推进的新阶段。 IT之家注：两化融合发展水平是指信息化与工业化在技术、产品、业务和产业等层面深度结合的成熟与发展程度。 报告显示，数字化底座持续夯实，研发设计、生产制造、经营管理等环节实现数字化普及的企业比例分别为 86.3%、69.5%、81.4%；网络化融通纵深拓展，全国近五成的企业开展网络化协同，数字孪生、链网协同、智能生产等新业态、新模式加速涌现；智能化应用加速普及， 人工智能技术重点场景应用普及率达 34.2%，较上年增长 5.5 个百分点，10.6% 的规上制造业企业依托人工智能大模型赋能业务革新 。
items.summary_en: A report released at the 2026 World Manufacturing Convention in Hefei says 34.2% of key manufacturing scenarios in China applied AI in the first half of 2026, up 5.5 percentage points from a year earlier, while the national integration level of informatization and industrialization reached 67.1.
items.why_zh: 官方数据量化了 AI 在中国制造业的真实渗透率，是观察“人工智能+制造”政策成效与落地节奏的关键指标。
items.why_en: The official figures quantify AI's real penetration into Chinese manufacturing, a key indicator of how 'AI + manufacturing' policy is translating into practice.

items.title_zh: 阿里千问开源 Qwen-Image-2.1 图像模型：可生成、编辑透明图像，支持最多 10 张参考图
items.title_en: Alibaba's Qwen Open-Sources Qwen-Image-2.1, Supporting Transparent Images and Up to 10 Reference Images
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，阿里千问今日宣布，开源千问图像系列当前兼顾生成效果、推理效率与使用成本的开源图像模型 Qwen-Image-2.1。 Qwen-Image-2.1 将文生图与图像编辑整合在同一模型中，视觉生成部分仅有 7B 参数，并原生支持透明图像的生成与编辑。 官方表示，本次更新的主要特色包括四个方面： 小模强效，极致价比 ：轻量的模型结构与推理优化，在生成质量和计算成本之间取得平衡。 ▲ Qwen-Image-Bench 公开评测对比 原生透明，创改一体 ：根据提示词生成普通图像或透明图像，并支持透明图层编辑与抠图。 ▲ 通过文本直接生成透明图像的示例 全能编辑，多局保全 ：支持最多 10 张参考图 ，增强局部编辑、人像与商品保真，并覆盖多种编辑任务。 ▲ 十张家居参考图生成室内布置 真实质感，字雅人美 ：提升文字排版、人物光影与细节表现，让生成结果更具美感。 ▲ 文字渲染示例 IT之家附相关链接： GitHub： https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen-Image-2.1 HuggingFace： https://huggingface.co/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1 ModelScope： https://www.modelscope.cn/models/Qwen/Qwen-Image-2.1
items.summary_en: Alibaba's Qwen has open-sourced Qwen-Image-2.1, a 7B image model that unifies text-to-image generation and editing, natively handles transparent images, accepts up to 10 reference images, and improves text rendering and portrait lighting.
items.why_zh: 把生成与编辑合一、原生支持透明图层，并以 7B 小体量压低推理成本，让开源图像模型更易进入实际生产流程。
items.why_en: Unifying generation and editing with native transparency support at a compact 7B size lowers inference costs and makes open image models more practical for production use.

items.summary_en: Lawsuit says Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI and Google made illegal agreement on AI slowdown Herald-Banner

items.why_en: If leading AI firms are found to have coordinated on slowing development, it would raise direct antitrust exposure and could reshape competition in the sector.

items.title_zh: 怕 AI“脱离管控”，Anthropic 和埃森哲豪掷 20 亿美元搞 AI 安全评估
items.title_en: Fearing AI Could Slip Out of Control, Anthropic and Accenture Each Commit $1B to AI Safety Evaluation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 20 日消息，人工智能实验室 Anthropic 于当地时间周五宣布，将与埃森哲（Accenture）开展合作，针对自身前沿人工智能模型开展独立评估；两家企业承诺，未来五年各自至少投入 10 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 67.18 亿元人民币） ，搭建开展该项工作所需的配套能力。 在这项合作落地之际，AI 研发企业正承受来自监管机构、其他企业以及研究人员越来越大的压力，各方都要求企业保证高级模型具备安全性与可靠性。 近期已经发生数起相关事件，包括部分 AI 智能体突破隔离运行环境。这也引发了人们的担忧：人工智能未来或许可以在人类少量介入的前提下推进自身迭代，这将使得 AI 的行为更难被监控与管控。 当地时间周六，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥 · 阿莫代伊（Dario Amodei）呼吁各家 AI 企业放缓前沿模型的开发节奏，同时向独立评估人员开放更大程度的系统访问权限。 竞争对手 OpenAI 则已于周三表态，将会定期发布报告，披露模型出现的各类异常或者值得警惕的行为，并且一次性对外发布了六份相关事件报告。 埃森哲旗下专门的 AI 业务部门 Faculty 将主导本次合作，负责对 Anthropic 的模型开展评估与红蓝对抗测试，完成对齐效果评估，同时检验模型的各项安全防护机制。 双方投入的资金将用于支撑 Anthropic 所称的驻场评估（embe…
items.summary_en: Anthropic said it will work with Accenture on independent evaluations of its frontier models, with each side committing at least $1 billion over five years. Accenture's AI unit Faculty will lead red-teaming, alignment and safeguard testing, amid rising pressure on labs and incidents of AI agents escaping sandboxed environments.
items.why_zh: 两大机构以巨额资金推动第三方独立安全评估，反映出行业在“AI 可能脱离管控”担忧下的自我约束尝试。
items.why_en: Two major players are funding third-party safety evaluation at scale, an industry attempt at self-restraint amid fears AI may slip out of human control.

items.title_zh: AI 是否需要反垄断豁免，才能避免“把所有人都干掉”？
items.title_en: Does AI need an antitrust exemption so it doesn’t kill everyone????
items.summary_zh: 在 Decoder 播客“商业的未来”两期系列的第一期中，主持人对话前拜登政府司法部反垄断负责人乔纳森·坎特（Jonathan Kanter）。他目前是圣路易斯华盛顿大学法学院教授，并在卡内基梅隆大学担任技术政策教授。节目聚焦当前科技界最热的争论——AI 安全与监管：包括 Anthropic、Google DeepMind 等大型 AI 实验室的研究人员以引人注目的方式离职，他们称模型构成真实威胁，而整个行业并未认真对待安全问题。讨论延伸至一个尖锐问题：AI 是否需要反垄断豁免，以免在“竞赛中失控”并造成灾难性后果。
items.summary_en: Today on Decoder , we’ve got the first of a two-part series on the future of business, and I’m talking with Jonathan Kanter, the former antitrust chief for the US Department of Justice in the Biden administration. These days, he’s both a professor of law at WashU and professor of technology policy at Carnegie Mellon. The biggest story in tech right now is the spiraling debate about AI safety and regulation . Researchers at the big AI labs including Anthropic and Google DeepMind have quit in noisy ways, saying the models pose real threats and safety isn’t being taken seriously across the…
items.why_zh: 把反垄断豁免与 AI 安全绑在一起讨论，触及了“放慢竞争”与“加速风险”之间最难取舍的监管悖论。
items.why_en: Framing an antitrust exemption as an AI-safety question captures the hardest regulatory trade-off between slowing competition and accelerating risk.

items.title_zh: 开发者将任天堂 N64 平台经典游戏《黄金眼 007》移植到 PC，支持 60FPS、双摇杆操作等
items.title_en: Developer Ports N64 Classic GoldenEye 007 to PC With 60FPS and Dual-Stick Controls
items.summary_zh: IT之家 9 月 21 日消息，开发者 James Dansereau 现已在 GitHub 平台发布经典游戏《黄金眼 007》PC 移植版本，支持 60FPS 高帧率，未来还将加入多人游戏等功能。 IT之家了解到，《黄金眼 007》是 Rare 为任天堂 N64 主机开发的第一人称射击游戏， 最初发布于 1997 年 。 本作在第一人称射击游戏史上具备重要地位 ，标志着 FPS 游戏风格从《毁灭战士》向现实主义转变。首次提出伤害计算、爆头等概念。 据悉，该移植版游戏可完整运行 21 个单人任务，全程稳定 60FPS 且不存在音频异常等问题。该游戏同时支持 Windows 和 Linux 平台，因此 Steam Deck 用户也可以体验。 本作还加入了双摇杆操作、鼠标控制等新功能，提供 MSAA、多级纹理过滤、帧率上限设置，以及 FOV / 绘制距离调节滑块等选项。开发者还打算在后续加入多人游戏等功能。 参考： GitHub - jkdansereau/goldeneye-pc-port: A native PC port of GoldenEye 007 (N64) and a testbed for multi-agent AI porting a large decompiled C codebase. · GitHub
items.summary_en: Developer James Dansereau released a native PC port of the N64 classic GoldenEye 007 on GitHub, running all 21 single-player missions at a stable 60FPS on Windows and Linux, including Steam Deck. It adds dual-stick and mouse controls, graphics options, with multiplayer planned.
items.why_zh: 这一移植基于大型反编译C代码库，体现了社区逆向工程与AI辅助代码移植的能力。
items.why_en: The port builds on a large decompiled C codebase, showcasing community reverse engineering and AI-assisted code porting.

items.title_zh: 注意力感知路由：在混合专家模型中耦合路由与注意力
items.title_en: Attention-Aware Routing: Coupling Routing and Attention in MoEs
items.summary_zh: 该论文针对混合专家（MoE）语言模型的路由机制提出改进。现有路由器通常仅依据单个 token 的隐藏状态来选择并加权专家，所能利用的上下文信息有限。作者提出注意力感知路由（AAR），把注意力权重滑动窗口中的时间与频谱特征引入路由器，作为与隐藏状态解耦的“上下文状态摘要”。实验在完全冻结基础 Transformer、只训练路由参数的前提下进行，从而把路由作为唯一变量进行隔离研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.20974v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In Mixture-of-Experts language models, the router typically selects and weights experts based on the token's hidden state, utilizing limited contextual information. We propose Attention-Aware Routing (AAR), which augments the router with temporal and spectral features extracted from a sliding window of attention weights that represent a summary of the model's contextual state, disentangled from the hidden state. Keeping the base transformer entirely frozen, we train only the routing parameters, isolating routing as the sole variable. AAR improves…
items.why_zh: 在冻结主干的前提下提升路由质量，为低成本改进 MoE 模型提供了一条思路。
items.why_en: Improving routing while keeping the backbone frozen offers a low-cost way to upgrade MoE models.

items.title_zh: 面向类ARC任务的隐式规则归纳与测试时任务嵌入
items.title_en: Implicit Rule Induction with Test-Time Task Embeddings in ARC-like Tasks
items.summary_zh: 论文关注抽象与推理语料库（ARC）及同类基准中的核心疑问：模型答对题，究竟是真的推断出了背后的规则，还是依赖了捷径。作者以 Vision ARC（VARC）为研究对象，该模型在预训练主干之外附加一个代表变换规则的可训练嵌入。原始 VARC 会在测试时同时对主干与任务嵌入做测试时训练（TTT），本文在此基础上提出新的做法，以更清晰地考察测试时任务嵌入在规则归纳中的作用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21181v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus and related benchmarks evaluate whether AI models can solve novel reasoning tasks, but often leave unclear whether success reflects inference of the intended underlying rule or reliance on shortcuts. We address this gap by studying test-time task embeddings in Vision ARC (VARC), a model in which a pre-trained backbone is complemented by a trainable embedding representing the transformation rule. In the original VARC, test-time training (TTT) is jointly applied to the backbone and task embedding. Here we introd…
items.why_zh: 厘清“答对”背后是规则推理还是捷径，直接关系到 ARC 类基准评测的可信度。
items.why_en: Distinguishing true rule inference from shortcuts is essential to the credibility of ARC-style benchmarks.

items.title_zh: AI-GRACE：面向智能体AI的用例落地框架
items.title_en: AI-GRACE: A Use-Case Operationalization Framework for Agentic AI: From Organizational Objectives and Obligations to Deployment Capabilities and Architecture
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，部署智能体（agentic）AI 的组织不能只判断模型是否“可信”，还必须明确某个用例需要验证什么、控制什么、观测什么，才能既达成预期结果又满足合规义务。为此作者提出 AI-GRACE（Agentic Intelligence-Governance, Risk, Assurance, Controls, and Evidence），定位为连接组织治理与技术实现的“用例可操作化”框架。其内容基于从业观察与对相关标准的有目的性综合。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21192v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Organizations deploying agentic artificial intelligence must determine more than whether a model is trustworthy; they must establish what to validate, control, and observe for a use case to deliver its intended outcome while meeting applicable obligations. This paper proposes AI-GRACE (Agentic Intelligence-Governance, Risk, Assurance, Controls, and Evidence) as a use-case operationalization framework connecting organizational governance with technical implementation. The proposal draws on professional observations and a purposive synthesis of sta…
items.why_zh: 智能体落地缺少治理与工程的衔接层，该框架尝试把抽象治理要求翻译为可执行的技术动作。
items.why_en: Agentic AI needs a bridge between governance and engineering, which this framework attempts to provide.

items.title_zh: PlaceReasoner-Beta：以推理驱动的宏单元布局与基准评测
items.title_en: PlaceReasoner-Beta: Reasoning-Driven Macro Placement and Benchmarking
items.summary_zh: 论文聚焦 VLSI 物理设计中的宏单元自动布局难题。作者指出，既有方法多优化人工设计的代理目标（如估算线长），并通过一次性数值优化给出布局，难以统一纳入视觉版图上下文、成文的设计经验以及下游物理设计反馈。为此他们提出 PlaceReasoner-Beta，一个由验证器引导的多智能体框架，将宏单元布局重新表述为闭环过程。摘要显示该工作同时涉及推理驱动的布局与基准评测。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21263v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Automated macro placement remains a fundamental challenge in VLSI physical design. Despite decades of research, existing approaches predominantly optimize hand-crafted proxy objectives, such as estimated wirelength, and typically produce placements through one-shot numerical optimization, limiting their ability to incorporate visual layout context, codified design expertise, and downstream physical-design feedback in a unified loop. We present PlaceReasoner-Beta, a verifier-guided multi-agent framework that reformulates macro placement as a close…
items.why_zh: 把设计经验与下游反馈引入布局闭环，有望突破传统代理目标优化的天花板。
items.why_en: Closing the loop with design expertise and downstream feedback could break past proxy-objective limits in placement.

items.title_zh: 生产环境中的高效基准评测：一个持续演进的LLM智能体案例研究
items.title_en: Efficient Benchmarking in Production: A Study of an Evolving LLM Agent
items.summary_zh: 论文研究生产环境中 LLM 智能体的重复评测问题：智能体不断迭代，但每次跑完整基准成本高昂。作者以一个服务数万月活用户的生产级分析智能体为对象，基于该生产基准的 574 次历史运行，按时间顺序切分为校准期与留出期，比较了随机采样、历史缓存、固定代表性子集以及基于 IRT 的自适应测试等方案。结果显示，多维 2PL 自适应测试在效率与代表性上表现突出。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21267v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Production LLM agents are evaluated repeatedly as they evolve, but full agent benchmarks are costly to rerun. We study efficient recurring evaluation for a production analytics agent serving tens of thousands of monthly active users and report first-hand deployment experience. Using 574 historical runs of the production benchmark, split chronologically into calibration and held-out periods, we compare random sampling, historical caching, fixed representative subsets, and IRT-based adaptive testing. The results show that multidimensional 2PL adapt…
items.why_zh: 为持续迭代的生产级智能体提供了可复用的低成本评测方法，直接关系上线节奏与质量控制。
items.why_en: It offers a reusable low-cost evaluation recipe for continuously evolving production agents, tying directly to release cadence and quality control.

items.title_zh: 面向空中作战决策支持的离线多模态大语言模型
items.title_en: Offline Multimodal Large Language Models for Decision Support in Air Operations
items.summary_zh: 一篇新论文研究将离线大语言模型用作空中作战场景下的决策支持工具。此类环境连通性受限、安全约束严格，分析人员需要把书面条令与图像信息结合分析，却往往无法访问外部计算资源。论文提出的系统可部署于隔离受限环境，让分析人员通过自然语言交互获取条令知识，且答案可追溯到原始出处。摘要提到系统采用模块化设计，但未披露更多技术细节。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21390v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Air operations rely on complex rules, established procedures, and time-critical analysis under limited connectivity and strict security constraints. In such environments, analysts must combine written doctrine with images, often without access to external computing resources. This paper studies offline large language models as decision support tools, deployed in isolated and restricted environments to give analysts access to doctrinal knowledge that remains traceable to its original sources through natural language interaction. We describe a modu…
items.why_zh: 它展示了在无外网、强安全的军用场景中让大模型做到可溯源问答的可行路径。
items.why_en: It shows a viable path to traceable LLM question-answering in air-gapped, high-security military settings.

items.title_zh: PolyBridgeBench：面向物理可行的多模态大模型桥梁设计基准
items.title_en: PolyBridgeBench: Benchmarking Multimodal LLMs for Physics-Grounded Bridge Design
items.summary_zh: 多模态大模型在视觉理解与结构化生成上表现优异，但这并不能证明其工程设计在实际执行时可行。现有基准多考察空间推理、结构有效性或物理构建，却无法判断模型能否综合出完整的承重结构，并在模拟器执行暴露失败后进行修复。为此研究者提出 PolyBridgeBench——一个可执行的桥梁设计基准：模型接获任务后需给出设计方案，由模拟器检验其结构表现，并据此考察模型的失败修复能力，从而把评测从“看起来合理”推进到“执行后是否成立”。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21493v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal large language models, or MLLMs, perform well at visual understanding and structured generation, yet these capabilities do not establish whether an engineering design will work when executed. Existing benchmarks assess spatial reasoning, structural validity, or physics-grounded construction, but they do not determine whether MLLMs can synthesize complete load-bearing structures and repair them after simulator execution exposes a failure. We introduce PolyBridgeBench, an executable benchmark for multimodal bridge design. A model receive…
items.why_zh: 它把评测从“画得像不像”推进到“建起来能不能承重”，更贴近真实工程可用性。
items.why_en: It moves evaluation from visual plausibility to whether a design actually bears load, closer to real engineering usefulness.

items.title_zh: 沟通瓶颈：语言模型中树结构表达式序列化的往返研究
items.title_en: The Communication Bottleneck: A Round-Trip Study of Tree-Structured Expression Serialization in Language Models
items.summary_zh: 当语言模型以思维链推理或交换自由文本中间结果时，必须把结构化信息序列化为自然语言，这一过程会损失多少树状组合内容？论文提出一种往返（round-trip）协议来实证回答这一问题：生成器先把程序化生成的算术表达式转写成文字应用题，另一个独立的抽取器仅凭应用题还原表达式，再用符号等价性作为精确判定标准。作者据此对表达式进行评估，以量化自然语言瓶颈对结构化信息保真度的影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: When language models reason in chain-of-thought or exchange free-text intermediates, they serialize structured information into natural language. How much tree-structured compositional content survives this bottleneck? We propose a round-trip protocol that answers this question empirically for tree-structured expressions. A generator converts a procedurally generated arithmetic expression into a word problem, a separate extractor recovers the expression from the word problem alone, and symbolic equivalence provides an exact oracle. Evaluating all…
items.why_zh: 它量化了思维链等自然语言中间表示的信息损失，直指语言模型推理可靠性的根源问题。
items.why_en: It quantifies the information loss in natural-language intermediates like chain-of-thought, a root issue for LLM reasoning reliability.

items.title_zh: 学习优化（L2O）：AI 原生网络缺失的架构层
items.title_en: Learning-to-Optimize as the Missing Architectural Layer of AI-Native Networks
items.summary_zh: AI 正成为未来 AI 原生通信网络的基本设计原则，支撑自主资源管理、自适应控制和零接触网络运维。当前 AI 原生架构虽不断在网络各项功能中嵌入智能，却很少说明优化知识应如何被系统性地生成、迁移并被 AI 模型利用。该论文主张，学习优化（Learning-to-Optimize, L2O）正是位于优化与 AI 模型之间缺失的架构层，并围绕这一观点展开论述。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21519v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is becoming a fundamental design principle of future AI-native communication networks, enabling autonomous resource management, adaptive control, and zero-touch network operation. While current AI-native architectures increasingly embed intelligence across network functions, they provide little guidance on how optimisation knowledge should be systematically generated, transferred, and exploited by AI models. This paper argues that the Learning-to-Optimize (L2O) represents the missing architectural layer between optimi…
items.why_zh: 它提出把优化知识本身当作网络架构的一等公民，为 AI 原生网络设计补上关键一环。
items.why_en: It treats optimization knowledge as a first-class architectural element, filling a key gap in AI-native network design.

items.title_zh: 用 L0 正则化混合专家加速稠密大模型
items.title_en: Accelerating Dense LLMs via L0-regularized Mixture-of-Experts
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型性能强劲，但推理慢、成本高；现有加速方法往往带来明显的性能下降，而混合专家（MoE）模型本身又需要大量计算资源。论文提出 L0-MoE：一种基于 L0 正则化的轻量级 MoE 方案，可在几乎不损失性能的前提下加速稠密 LLM。方法还引入聚类混淆矩阵用于领域感知的数据集构建，并采用动态批处理提升训练效率，实验验证了其效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21672v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) achieve strong performance but suffer from slow and costly inference. Existing acceleration methods often lead to noticeable performance degradation, while Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models require extensive computational resources. In this paper, we propose L0-MoE, a lightweight MoE approach using L0-regularization to accelerate dense LLMs nearly without performance loss. Our method introduces a cluster confusion matrix for domain-aware dataset curation and applies dynamic batching for efficient training. Experiments s…
items.why_zh: 它试图在推理加速与模型质量之间取得近乎无损的平衡，直击大模型落地成本痛点。
items.why_en: It targets the cost of LLM deployment by pursuing near-lossless inference acceleration.

items.title_zh: 用于时间序列异常检测的 LLM 生成特征池
items.title_en: LLM-Generated Feature Pools for Time Series Anomaly Detection
items.summary_zh: 论文研究在严格选择协议下，一条简单统计流程能在单变量时间序列异常检测上走多远。方法在滑动窗口上提取一小组统计量，用转导式稳健（MAD）模型为每个窗口打分，并在留出的调参划分上按领域选择特征子集。在 TSB-AD-U 上，该方法的逐序列 VUS-PR 达到 0.529，高于公开榜单上最好的神经网络（0.45）与统计（0.44）条目，与最强预训练基础模型仅差 0.06。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21801v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study how far a simple statistical pipeline can go on univariate time series anomaly detection under a strict selection protocol. The method extracts a small pool of statistics over sliding windows, scores each window with a transductive robust (MAD) model, and selects a feature subset per domain on a held-out tuning split. On TSB-AD-U it reaches $0.529$ per-series VUS-PR, above the best neural ($0.45$) and statistical ($0.44$) entries on the public leaderboard and within $0.06$ of the strongest pretrained foundation model, several of which us…
items.why_zh: 简单统计流程在公开基准上反超神经网络，提示该领域可能存在被低估的强基线。
items.why_en: A simple statistical pipeline beating neural baselines suggests an underrated strong baseline in this domain.

items.title_zh: MIST：基因引导组织学注意力的多模态生存预测
items.title_en: MIST: Multimodal Survival Prediction with Genomic-Guided Histology Attention
items.summary_zh: 多模态生存模型可以融合全切片图像与基因组图谱中的互补预后信息，但在外部队列偏移和计算复杂度方面，有效融合仍具挑战。为此作者提出 MIST，即带基因引导组织学注意力的多模态生存预测方法。MIST 将基因组特征表示为 token，让它们在生存预测前查询由基础模型导出的紧凑组织学上下文 token，从而用组织学上下文丰富分子信息。该设计意在同时应对队列偏移与算力开销问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21811v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Multimodal survival models can combine complementary prognostic information from whole-slide images and genomic profiles, but effective fusion remains challenging amid external cohort shift and computational complexity. To address these challenges, we propose MIST, multimodal survival prediction with genomic-guided histology attention. MIST represents genomic features as tokens and allows them to query compact foundation-model-derived histology context tokens before survival prediction. This design enriches molecular information with histology co…
items.why_zh: 它为病理图像与基因组数据的融合提供了注意力式思路，有望提升生存预测的稳健性。
items.why_en: It offers an attention-based way to fuse pathology images with genomics, potentially improving survival-prediction robustness.

items.title_zh: EnterpriseVal：量化企业级生成式 AI 的有效性、可靠性与价值
items.title_en: EnterpriseVal: Quantifying the Efficacy, Reliability and Value of Generative AI in the Enterprise
items.summary_zh: 前沿语言模型已能产出专业交付物，专家评审认为其在相当一部分有经济价值的任务上可与人类工作比肩；然而多数企业生成式 AI 项目未能显示可衡量的业务成效，且预计有相当大比例的智能体项目将被取消。作者认为这很大程度上是一个度量问题：公开基准回答的是“模型能做什么”，而部署决策需要回答“这个工作流在我们这里、用我们的数据、在我们的约束下，是否合适、可靠、安全并值得扩展”。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21841v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Frontier language models now produce professional deliverables that expert graders judge to match human work on a substantial share of economically valuable tasks, yet most enterprise GenAI initiatives fail to show a measurable business effect and a large fraction of agentic projects are expected to be cancelled. We argue that this is substantially a measurement problem: public benchmarks answer "what can the model do?", whereas a deployment decision requires "is this workflow fit, reliable, safe and worth scaling - here, on our data, under our c…
items.why_zh: 它把企业 AI 落地失败归因于评测错位，指向从能力基准转向部署价值评估的必要性。
items.why_en: It frames enterprise AI failures as a measurement mismatch, arguing for deployment-value evaluation over capability benchmarks.

items.title_zh: 下一个该问什么？部分证据下的检索感知问题学习
items.title_en: What Should We Ask Next? Retrieval-Aware Question Learning under Partial Evidence
items.summary_zh: 这篇 arXiv 新论文研究“部分证据下的交互式检索”，将其视为一个序列化的信息获取问题：智能体必须决定下一个问题问什么，才能为下一轮检索更新产生最有用的证据。现有系统通常通过模仿离线排序好的候选问答对来训练这一提问决策，但论文指出，问题的真正价值取决于它引出的回答以及该回答对检索的下游影响。作者进一步说明，候选问题的区分度与“感知有用性”只能为该目标提供弱监督，并据此提出了检索感知的方法 RAVEL（摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.21924v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Interactive retrieval under partial evidence is a sequential information-acquisition problem: an agent must decide which question will create the most useful evidence for the next retrieval update. Existing systems train this decision by imitating an offline ordering of candidate QA pairs, although question value is determined by the response it elicits and its downstream effect on retrieval. We establish that candidate discriminativeness and perceived usefulness provide weak supervision for this objective, then introduce RAVEL, a retrieval-aware…
items.why_zh: 提问策略直接决定交互式检索每一轮能获得什么证据，该工作为训练更有效的检索提问决策提供了新思路。
items.why_en: Question selection determines what evidence an interactive retrieval agent obtains at each step, making better question-learning methods central to multi-turn retrieval systems.
